{{Quote|I was shot down over Tieos. These are definitely not the guys you want to find you.|Wedge Antilles, on Galactic Empire repulsorlift companies in an annotation made in a copy of ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Tieos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWR" /> located in the [[Tieos system/Legends|Tieos system]], a part of the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet featured several [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] on its surface, and its landmasses were completely covered in [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]]. Shortly following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tieos held massive future potential as an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]].<ref name="SWR" />

The [[T. Alvak's father|father]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[TIE pilot]] [[T. Alvak]] at one point served as senior [[Portmaster/Legends|port master]] of the Imperial base on Tieos.<ref name="SWS2" /> At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was shot down over Tieos. In an annotation<ref name="IH" /> he<ref name="DB Wedge">{{DB|character|wedgeantilles|Antilles, Wedge}}</ref> later made in a captured copy of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] manual ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', Antilles mentioned the incident, further noting that downed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] should put maximum effort into avoiding being discovered by [[Repulsorlift company|repulsorlift companies]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="IH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tieos was first mentioned in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', a [[1987]] supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> The planet's first full appearance came in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], which also provided Tieos's only visual depiction&mdash;an image also used to illustrate eighteen other worlds in the game.<ref name="SWR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the Tieos [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square S-15.<ref name="TEA" />
